title: Early Upper Paleolithic Bone Needle from the Main Chamber of Denisova Cave (Based on Research Data from the 2016 Excavations)
version: Problemy arkheologii, etnografii, antropologii Sibiri i sopredelnykh territorii XXII, 72–75. Institute of Archaeology and Ethnography, Siberian Branch, Russian Academy of Sciences. Russian original with English abstract.
lineage: Original excavation and use-wear report. The excavator's 2025 article reproduces the same needle image and is not a new specimen. The dates cited for site layers are contextual and the 50,300 ± 2200 BP measurement is from a cut-marked bone in the East Chamber.

passages.locator: pp. 72–75, especially pp. 72–74 and Figs. 1–2 (same PDF pages)
passages.note: The complete eyed bone needle came from Main Chamber lithological horizon 11.2. Microscopy found polish and other use traces; the authors infer use of a fine thread from the eye, but no thread survived with this artefact. They report a lower-limit radiocarbon result for the middle of Main Chamber layer 11, separate from the dated bone in the East Chamber.
